motion.name: navigation-state
motion.purpose: Header color transitions and icon hover displacement.

motion.name: name-entrance
motion.purpose: 14 individual entrances; printing and scans are smooth. Index 2 assembles nine clipped fragments; index 9 assembles six exploded fragments, animating transform and opacity over fixed clip bounds.

motion.name: letter-scan
motion.purpose: Brief accent scan or type cursor accompanying individual entrances.

motion.name: shape-phase
motion.value: 14s; randomized initial phase and shape order per body
motion.purpose: Snapped lattice-rest, assembly, rotation, growth, five-target morphing, splitting, and dissolution with anchor tethers. Crypto randomness also varies initial travel, lane, and spin; root-layout mounting preserves motion across client page changes.

motion.name: pointer-smoothing
motion.purpose: Smoothly blend pointer position and influence, including decay. Forms alone deform and receive cursor-velocity impulses, spin, strain, damped flight, and approximate spherical collision impulses while assembled; affected faces fade. Grid projection stays pointer-independent.

motion.name: motion-accessibility
motion.purpose: Disable CSS animation/transitions and settle the canvas; hidden tabs stop rendering.

motion.name: volume-travel
motion.purpose: Shared world-space projection carries bodies back left to front right, nearer the camera, with faded recycling. New laps reset flight offset, velocity, and strain, and randomize the lane, lifecycle phase, and shape order. The five-plane lattice advances without pointer deformation.

narrative.northStar: Open content over a tactical graph
narrative.overview:
The approved open-layout-v6 direction places clear, warm typography over a quiet technical background. Foreground content is unboxed, left aligned, and spacious. Soft charcoal and dusty red temper the angular geometry; the professional portfolio leads the site’s identity.

Movement belongs to the spatial field and the name’s first entrance. A shared world-space projection carries a five-plane lattice and three angular clusters from back left toward front right, advancing rightward and nearer the camera. Shape nodes begin at snapped lattice intersections, assemble into rotating forms, grow, morph, split, and dissolve back into the lattice with anchor tethers. Bright beacons pulse at intersections. The lattice projection stays independent of the pointer. Forms alone deform and receive cursor-velocity impulses, rotation, strain, and damped flight; disrupted faces fade while readable foreground content stays stable. Decorative content icons are excluded, while functional header controls and GitHub, LinkedIn, and email icons remain.
keyCharacteristics: Soft charcoal, dusty red, and warm gray.
Angular background depth with restrained pointer response.
Individual letter entrances that settle into readable text.
Functional navigation and truthful, intentionally blank media placeholders.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use the existing dusty red family for interaction and geometry; do not introduce a second competing accent.

rules.name: The Readable Finish Rule
rules.body: Entrance animation must resolve to stable, unobscured text; the full name remains available to assistive technology throughout.

rules.name: The Background Geometry Rule
rules.body: Keep tactical lines and grids behind the content. Foreground sections remain open and unboxed.

dos: Do keep text and navigation readable and stable above the reactive background.
Do use Chakra Petch for the homepage name, Manrope for supporting type, and the existing charcoal/red palette across routes.
Do preserve keyboard focus, expanded control states, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep unsupplied media visibly identified as placeholders.
Do place each navigation destination on its own page and keep Home as the introduction.
donts: Don't add decorative content icons; retain icons that serve header links or controls.
Don't turn open foreground content into tactical panels, tables, or bordered cards.
Don't substitute stark black/crimson contrast or flowing ribbon geometry for the chosen direction.
Don't invent photographs, project screenshots, forms, or component variants absent from the implementation.
